about.description: Branchable computing by using a portable, lightweight, self-contained virtual machine
about.head: e2966ad

name: smolvm v1.16.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Speed up pack compression with bounded zstd workers by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1243
* Fix checkpoint restore port collisions and startup diagnostics by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1248
* Reuse cached image layers for offline exports by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1244
* Allow retrying machines after failed image pulls by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1250
* Fix exports from stopped branches by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1251
* Size the pack extraction cache from the disk instead of a fixed 5 GiB by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1249
* Bundle sparse branchable memory promotion by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1252
* cuda: expose VMM allocation APIs to PyTorch by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1256
* Stream checkpoint artifacts without redundant file passes by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1253
* Avoid redundant checkpoint RAM copies on Linux by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1257
* Keep packed image extraction out of metadata queries by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1261
* Quiesce guest storage before graceful shutdown by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1260
* Map shared image layers into export helpers by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1258
* Restore prepared checkpoints safely from the node cache by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1259
* Expose workload image in machine responses by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1262
* Clean up cancelled checkpoint captures by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1263
* Update rustls to address RustSec advisory by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1268
* Keep machines responsive and recoverable while checkpoints save by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1269
* Fix failures when restoring the same checkpoint concurrently by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1272
* Keep checkpoint restores isolated under private service permissions by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1276
* Avoid connection delays after restoring a machine by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1273
* Accept published-port connections without polling delays by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1274
* Complete partial writes when copying checkpoint disks by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1277
* Share immutable checkpoint disks between restored machines by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1278
* Prepare SmolVM v1.16.1 for release by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1280


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/compare/v1.16.0...v1.16.1
